title: test(docs): close redirect renderer fixture dependencies
summary: The fixture lock includes the complete redirect plugin dependency chain.
details: Pin mkdocs-redirects 1.2.3 and properdocs 1.6.7 alongside the admitted MkDocs/Material renderer.
Installed-package ownership and payload checks cover Linux Python 3.12 and Darwin Python 3.14; the resulting 32-pin environment requires its own renderer observation.
